summary: All 3 blocking findings are valid and require direct spec repair before spec-gate.

items.title: Define stable WorkUnit checkpoint lookup key
items.rationale: The spec needs a stable unitId lookup key that excludes volatile identity fields so stale detection can compare the stored full identity against the planned full identity.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0] explains that using a full identity hash as unitId would turn changed inputs into missing checkpoints, while using only order would collide across chunk, cross-check, parent, and child units.

items.title: Specify impl tooling-failure runner contract
items.rationale: The spec must define how WorkUnit tooling failures cross the impl review subprocess boundary so failed checkpoints do not become generic subprocess failures or semantic review results.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[1] notes that current impl parsing expects final artifacts and impl lifecycle can increment reviewRetry for impl artifacts.

items.title: Define retryable WorkUnit failure classification
items.rationale: Fallback splitting depends on two retryable failures for the same loop-chunk WorkUnit, so checkpoint failureKind values need an explicit retryable mapping.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[2] states that provider, timeout, parser, and schema failures are not yet mapped to chunk-level fallback policy.
